lines.en: I collapse into bed after being dropped off at the hotel by Maki.
lines.zh: Maki 把我送回酒店后，我一头栽倒在床上。

lines.en: I was hoping that by sticking around for so long and watching so many girls get intoxicated, that one of them might let their judgement slip and make my night a bit more interesting.
lines.zh: 我本指望在那儿赖那么久、看那么多女孩喝醉，总有哪个会失去判断，让我这个夜晚变得有意思点。

lines.en: But here I lay, in the same clothes I slept in last night, completely alone.
lines.zh: 可现在我躺在这儿，穿着昨晚睡觉的那身衣服，孤零零一个人。
床上有 Io 的味道。

lines.en: She probably slept here for a few hours after I left this morning.
lines.zh: 今早我走后，她大概在这儿睡了几个小时。

lines.en: I wonder if she’ll come again tonight.
lines.zh: 不知道她今晚还会不会来。

lines.en: I imagine the sound of her knocking, worried that one of the other girls might be rounding the corner at that moment.
lines.zh: 我想象着她的敲门声——她会担心那一刻别的女孩会不会正好拐过走廊。

lines.en: She’d peer over her shoulder every few seconds while I make my way to the door- an explanation or excuse already prepared in the event of being caught.
lines.zh: 我走向门口时，她每隔几秒就回头瞟一眼——一套说辞或借口早已备好，以防被撞见。

lines.en: An explanation that she’d probably throw away the second she's confronted.
lines.zh: 一套她多半一被当场质问就会扔掉的借口。

lines.en: What an adorable coward she is.
lines.zh: 真是个可爱的小怂包。

lines.en: It would be nice if she came tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚她要是来就好了。

lines.en: Perhaps I wasn’t imagining anything at all?
lines.zh: 也许我根本没在胡思乱想？

lines.en: I get off the bed and make my way over to the door.
lines.zh: 我下了床，走到门边。

lines.en: It appears I won’t have to be alone after all.
lines.zh: 看来我不用一个人了。
: 你……还走得动？
: 我的脸……感觉……{i}*嗝*{/i}……好奇怪……

lines.en: Welp, there is absolutely no way that at least one of them won’t be regretting this in the morning.
lines.zh: 得，明早她们俩至少有一个绝对会后悔的。
: Sensei……你在干嘛呀？……
: 我们还没……{i}*嗝*{/i}……玩够呢……

lines.en: : Really, how did you two even get over here? You could barely walk when we left the bar.
lines.zh: : 说真的，你们俩怎么摸到这儿来的？离开酒吧那会儿你们路都走不稳。
: 这是……{i}*嗝*{/i}……爱的力量，Sensei！
: 现在……我们……{i}*嗝*{/i}……来亲亲吧……

lines.en: : And was Touka brought here by the power of love as well?
lines.zh: : Touka 也是被「爱的力量」带来的？
: 爱听着……好美……
: Touka……没事的……

lines.en: : We were just {i}*hic*{/i}...talking about our...dates with you...
lines.zh: : 我们刚才只是在……{i}*嗝*{/i}……聊跟你约会的事……

lines.en: : And how I...{i}*hic*{/i}...kicked her big, rich butt!
lines.zh: : 还聊到我……{i}*嗝*{/i}……把你这个有钱的大家伙踹赢了！

lines.en: : Yeah! I’ve gotta...bone to...{i}*hic*{/i}...pick with you!
lines.zh: : 对！我得跟你……{i}*嗝*{/i}……算笔账！
: {i}你知不知道我是谁？{/i}

lines.en: : You dare defy...{i}my{/i} family and say that {i}my{/i} date...{i}*hic*{/i} was the worse one?!
lines.zh: : 你竟敢违抗……{i}我的{/i}家族，说{i}我的{/i}约会……{i}*嗝*{/i}……比较差？！

lines.en: : You seemed a lot more okay with this when you were sober.
lines.zh: : 你清醒那会儿，对这事可没那么大意见。

lines.en: : Well I ain’t {i}*hic*{/i} okay now, buddy! Now get on the friggin’ ground and {i}*hic*{/i} kiss my boots!
lines.zh: : 可我现在就是{i}*嗝*{/i}有意见，老兄！现在给我趴到地上，{i}*嗝*{/i}亲我的靴子！
: Touka……我们进门就把鞋脱了……忘了？……

lines.en: : You don’t have any {i}*hic*{/i} boots on right now...
lines.zh: : 你现在{i}*嗝*{/i}根本没穿靴子……

lines.en: : You {i}*hic*{/i} did this on purpose...didn’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你{i}*嗝*{/i}是故意的……对不对？！

lines.en: : You thought that {i}*hic*{/i} by stealing my boots...you could sell ‘em and {i}*hic*{/i} buy yourself a new house!
lines.zh: : 你以为{i}*嗝*{/i}偷了我的靴子……就能拿去卖掉、{i}*嗝*{/i}给自己买栋新房子！

lines.en: : Noooooo we just had to be quiet so nobody would hear us come, remember?
lines.zh: : 不——是啦，我们得轻手轻脚，免得别人听见我们来了，记得吗？
: 那……你们{i}来{/i}干嘛？
: 嘿……你觉得我好看，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes, Chika. You should be well aware of this.
lines.zh: : 对，Chika。你应该很清楚这一点。
: 那我{i}*嗝*{/i}比 Touka 好看吗？
: 呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Nonono issokay. You can...answer however you want.
lines.zh: : 别别别，没事的。你……想怎么答就怎么答。

lines.en: : Yeah, here’s the thing. I don’t really {i}want{/i} to answer that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，是这样。我不太{i}想{/i}回答这个问题。

lines.en: : Ha! I win! He said...Touka is...the beautiful one and...Chika is a peasant!
lines.zh: : 哈！我赢了！他说……Touka 才是……漂亮的那个，而……Chika 是个乡巴佬！

lines.en: : That’s not even remotely- Touka, do you need to go to the hospital or something?
lines.zh: : 我根本没——Touka，你是不是该去医院看看？

lines.en: : Your face is a hospital! Kiss my boots!
lines.zh: : 你的脸就是医院！亲我的靴子！

lines.en: : So {i}*hic*{/i}...you remember how you {i}*hic*{/i} told me you love me and...chose me to win the thing before Touka even got a chance?...
lines.zh: : 那个{i}*嗝*{/i}……你还记不记得你{i}*嗝*{/i}说过你爱我、还……在 Touka 有机会之前就选我赢了？……

lines.en: : That was only several hours ago. I remember it well.
lines.zh: : 那才几个小时前。我记得很清楚。

lines.en: : Do you also {i}*hic*{/i} remember the...{i}*hic*{/i}...promise we made at the mall?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}*嗝*{/i}还记不记得我们在商场……{i}*嗝*{/i}……许下的约定？
: 约定？我不太——
: 等等。

lines.en: : Touka’s got some...really expensive {i}*hic*{/i} underwear, Sensei...And she thinks it’ll make you think she’s {i}*hic*{/i} prettier than me...
lines.zh: : Touka 有件……特别贵的{i}*嗝*{/i}内衣，Sensei……她觉得那能让你觉得她{i}*嗝*{/i}比我好看……
: 真……好笑……我不……{i}*嗝*{/i}……记得我说过……
: 嘘——没事的，Touka……
: 我……不太舒服……
: 所以——你懂这意味着什么了吧？

lines.en: : You know, the idea of you modeling lingerie for me in a dressing room was already pretty great-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，让你在试衣间给我试穿内衣这主意本来就很棒了——

lines.en: : But the idea of it happening here with a...companion instead? You’re really pulling out all the stops for me today, huh?
lines.zh: : 可现在是在这儿、还带了个……伴儿？你今天真是为我下血本了啊？
: 那……是什么意思，Sensei？……

lines.en: : You tryin’ to say you wanna get...more girls involved?
lines.zh: : 你是想说你想……多拉几个女孩进来？

lines.en: : Am I not {i}*hic*{/i} good enough for you anymore?!
lines.zh: : 我现在{i}*嗝*{/i}配不上你了是吗？！

lines.en: : Chika...{i}you{/i} were the one who brought her here. Not me.
lines.zh: : Chika……带她来的是{i}你{/i}，不是我。

lines.en: : I didn’t even know you were coming.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你们要来。

lines.en: : Well {i}*hic*{/i} don’t think you’ll be gettin’ a hook that easy, mister!
lines.zh: : 哼，{i}*嗝*{/i}你可想得太美了，先生！
: 是「{i}别想得逞{/i}」，Chika。

lines.en: : Shut up! I know my rights!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我清楚我的权利！

lines.en: : What do your rights have to do with modeling lingerie for me?
lines.zh: : 你的权利跟给我试穿内衣有什么关系？
: 性感的{i}*嗝*{/i}权利！

lines.en: : Touka ain’t got {i}*hic*{/i} shit on me! I bet her underwear’s not even that {i}*hic*{/i} hot!
lines.zh: : Touka {i}*嗝*{/i}算什么东西！我赌她的内衣根本没那么{i}*嗝*{/i}辣！
: 内……什么？
: 我们……在哪儿？

lines.en: : You’re in my room, Touka. Do you need to sit down?
lines.zh: : 你在我的房间，Touka。要不要坐下？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea who I am?!
lines.zh: : 你知不知道我是谁？！

lines.en: : How {i}dare{/i} you talk to me like that!
lines.zh: : 你{i}怎么敢{/i}那样跟我说话！
: 我只是问……

lines.en: : You know what, fuck it. Just do whatever it is you two came here to do which, by the context of the conversation, I imagine involves stripping.
lines.zh: : 行了，懒得管了。你们俩来这儿想干嘛就干嘛吧——照这对话的走向，我猜是要脱衣服。

lines.en: : Ay! Stop tellin’ my new friend to strip when ya got me! Yer own personal {i}*hic*{/i} stripper!
lines.zh: : 哎！有我在还让我的新朋友脱？我可是你专属的{i}*嗝*{/i}脱衣舞娘！
: 有水吗？！

lines.en: : There’s a sink in the bathroom, Touka.
lines.zh: : 浴室里有水槽，Touka。
: 谢谢！
Touka 钻进了——
: 那是衣柜，Touka。

lines.en: : {i}Excuse{/i} me?! Do you have {i}any{/i} idea who I am?
lines.zh: : {i}你说什么{/i}？！你{i}知不知道{/i}我是谁？
我刚才说到——

lines.en: Touka disappears into the bathroom (Correctly this time) and...probably drinks directly out of the faucet because I don’t think there’s a glass in there.
lines.zh: Touka 钻进了浴室（这次对了）然后……多半直接对着水龙头喝了，因为我想里面没杯子。

lines.en: Of course, this means I am now left alone with a scowling and {i}extremely{/i} drunk Chika, who I still need to figure out how to deal with.
lines.zh: 当然，这就意味着，我现在得单独面对一个气鼓鼓、醉得{i}厉害{/i}的 Chika，而我还没想好怎么应付她。

lines.en: : My idea not...good enough for you or something?
lines.zh: : 我的主意……不够好还是怎样？

lines.en: : You still haven’t even really established what your idea {i}is{/i}, but based on how this weekend has gone, I imagine it will be in the form of a contest.
lines.zh: : 你到现在都还没说清楚你的主意到底{i}是{/i}什么，不过照这周末的架势，我猜会变成一场比赛。

lines.en: : That’s {i}*hic*{/i} right! I’m gonna take off my clothes and you’re gonna {i}*hic*{/i} say lots of stuff about how pretty I am!
lines.zh: : 没{i}*嗝*{/i}错！我要把衣服脱了，然后你得{i}*嗝*{/i}说一堆我有多好看的话！
: 那 Touka 呢？
: 你带来的那个……女孩。
: 哦，对哦。

lines.en: : I don’t know. She’ll do the same, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概也照做吧。
: 你没意见？
: {i}对什么没意见？{/i}
: 怎么了？

lines.en: : With another girl stripping for me.
lines.zh: : 对另一个女孩为我脱衣服没意见。
: 谁？！我弄死她！

lines.en: : Really...{i}how{/i} did you two even make it down the hall?
lines.zh: : 说真的……你们俩到底{i}怎么{/i}走完那段走廊的？

lines.en: Touka comes out of the bathroom several minutes later and seems at least...slightly better.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Touka 从浴室出来，看着至少……好了一丁点。

lines.en: But, of course things continue to progress and, somehow or another, we wind up like this.
lines.zh: 可事情自然继续发展，不知怎么的，就变成了这副局面。
: 好了……现在……说我赢了……
: 那水……真好喝……

lines.en: : I feel {i}*hic*{/i} like a brand new girl...
lines.zh: : 我感觉{i}*嗝*{/i}自己脱胎换骨了……

lines.en: Needless to say, it’s an interesting night.
lines.zh: 不用说，这是个奇妙的夜晚。

lines.en: And honestly, I’m not even going to say I can be blamed for this one.
lines.zh: 而且说实话，这次我可不打算承认能怪我。

lines.en: I mean, sure. I did let them into my room. And hung out with them as they got drunk.
lines.zh: 我是说，没错。我确实让她们进了我的房间。也确实在她们喝醉时陪着。

lines.en: But I was more than willing to go to sleep without being the judge of a lingerie contest.
lines.zh: 可我本来是打算直接睡觉、不来当什么内衣大赛评委的。
可结果，我们到了这地步。

lines.en: : Sensei {i}*hic*{/i}...I know you’ve seen mine before, but...they still turn you on, right?...
lines.zh: : Sensei {i}*嗝*{/i}……我知道你以前见过我的，但……它们还是能勾起你的兴致，对吧？……

lines.en: : Want me to strip for you more often? I’ll do it, you know.
lines.zh: : 想让我以后多脱给你看吗？我会的，说真的。
: 你在{i}*嗝*{/i}跟谁说话？
: 当然是 Sensei。
: Sensei？……
: 这里不是试衣间吗？……

lines.en: : You know, in an extremely roundabout way, it kind of is.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，拐了八百个弯来说，这儿还真算。

lines.en: : Eyes over here, Sensei. Don’t look at her.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看这边，Sensei。别看她。

lines.en: : Chika, you can’t invite her in, have her lift her shirt up, ask me to judge a lingerie contest, and then command that I don’t pay any attention to her.
lines.zh: : Chika，是你把她叫进来、让她撩起上衣、让我评一场内衣大赛，然后你又命令我不许看她。

lines.en: : I can do {i}*hic*{/i} whatever I want. I’m your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我想{i}*嗝*{/i}干嘛就干嘛。我是你女朋友。

lines.en: : You really need to stop saying that out loud so frequently.
lines.zh: : 你真别老把这句话挂在嘴边。

lines.en: : What? {i}*hic*{/i}...It’s not like...Touka’s gonna remember anything that happened tonight anyway.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？{i}*嗝*{/i}……反正……Touka 明早什么都记不得了。

lines.en: : Touka barely remembers where she is {i}right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : Touka {i}现在{/i}连自己身在哪儿都记不清。

lines.en: : See what I mean? Win win.
lines.zh: : 瞧见没？双赢。

lines.en: : I’m probably {i}*hic*{/i} not even gonna remember this.
lines.zh: : 我{i}*嗝*{/i}大概连这个都记不住。

lines.en: : That seems way too convenient to be true.
lines.zh: : 那也太便宜你了，不像真的。

lines.en: : Just {i}*hic*{/i} judge the...friggin’ underwear already, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 赶紧{i}*嗝*{/i}评这破……内衣吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m getting a closer look for more...accurate judgement.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过我得凑近点，好做出更……准确的评判。
: 请便～

lines.en: : You look a lot like my teacher...
lines.zh: : 你长得真像我老师……

lines.en: : What a strange coincidence that is.
lines.zh: : 真是个奇妙的巧合。

lines.en: : Do I win yet? Can we make out?
lines.zh: : 我赢了没？我们能亲亲了吗？

lines.en: : Feast your eyes upon...the body of...a goddess...
lines.zh: : 尽情欣赏……这具……女神的身体……
: 我……正看得起劲呢。
: 不过……
: 想看我们的屁股吗？
: 我是说——

lines.en: : That’s not where I was going with that. But-
lines.zh: : 我刚才不是要往那儿说。不过——
: 好啊！

lines.en: : Hey! Don’t go gettin’ all eager!
lines.zh: : 喂！别这么来劲！

lines.en: : Me? Eager? Do you have {i}any{/i} idea who I am?
lines.zh: : 我？来劲？你{i}知不知道{/i}我是谁？

lines.en: : How many times are you gonna friggin’ say that?!
lines.zh: : 这句话你到底要说几遍？！

lines.en: : Just that once...cause...that’s all I need, Chika...
lines.zh: : 就这一次……因为……有这一次就够了，Chika……

lines.en: : Now {i}*hic*{/i}...step aside...and...witness the beauty that is...Touka!
lines.zh: : 现在{i}*嗝*{/i}……让开……好好见识一下……Touka 的美貌！

lines.en: Touka clumsily hikes up her dress and hobbles over to the desk, leaning down on it in a way that makes it seem more like she’s trying to regain her balance than to model.
lines.zh: Touka 笨手笨脚地撩起裙子，踉跄着挪到桌边，往桌上一趴——那架势与其说是在摆造型，不如说是在找回平衡。

lines.en: I go to take a step toward her to...judge better, but Chika manages to control her hand eye coordination long enough to grab my wrist and pull me back.
lines.zh: 我往前迈一步想……看得更清，Chika 总算稳住她的手眼协调，一把抓住我的手腕把我拉了回来。
: 你该觉得……{i}*嗝*{/i}走运，乡巴佬……

lines.en: : To be graced with such a {i}*hic*{/i}...vision is...something not anyone else can say.
lines.zh: : 能有幸目睹这样的{i}*嗝*{/i}……景象……可不是谁都能说得起的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I didn’t really think it was.
lines.zh: : 是……我本来也没觉得别人能。

lines.en: : How much did you drink, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你到底喝了多少，Touka？

lines.en: : Silence! You shall not...talk while...observing the temple that is...my body!
lines.zh: : 肃静！瞻仰我这具……神圣躯体时……不许……说话！

lines.en: : Okay. Sorry, Chika, but I need to get a little bit closer in order to-
lines.zh: : 好吧。抱歉，Chika，但我得再凑近点才能——
: 哦，休想！

lines.zh: Chika 把我推倒在床上，爬到我身上，脱掉裙子和上衣——动作比 Touka 利落些，但远谈不上优雅。
: 我{i}现在{/i}赢了吗，Sensei？

lines.zh: : 算了，别回答。因为我知道答案肯定是「是」。

lines.en: : Chika wins! Clothes back on, Touka.
lines.zh: : Chika 赢了！Touka，把衣服穿上。
: 我真的……好晕……

lines.en: : Chika, you are aware that this is getting to a point where I will no longer be able to hold myself back, correct?
lines.zh: : Chika，你清不清楚，再这样下去我就快忍不住自己了？
: 那是什么意思，Sensei？～

lines.en: : It means that you are in a very dangerous location right now.
lines.zh: : 意思是你现在待的地方非常危险。

lines.en: : I’m exactly where I want to be.
lines.zh: : 我正是在我想待的地方。

lines.en: : Grab me and show whatshername that I’m the only girl who can {i}really{/i} excite you.
lines.zh: : 抓住我，让那个谁看看，只有我才能{i}真正{/i}勾起你的兴致。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t...{i}*hic*{/i}...be so sure about that, peasant!
lines.zh: : 我可……{i}*嗝*{/i}……不敢苟同，乡巴佬！

lines.en: Touka, by some miracle, manages to get the rest of her clothes off and now stands at the foot of my bed in nothing but her underwear.
lines.zh: Touka 不知怎么奇迹般地把剩下的衣服也脱了，此刻只穿着内衣站在我床尾。
: {i}现在{/i}，你可以起反应了。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of you, Touka. Being rich doesn’t...automatically make you sexier.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你，Touka。有钱……并不会自动让你更性感。
: 但「{i}更性感{/i}」会。

lines.en: : That line really wasn’t as good as it sounded in your head, Touka.
lines.zh: : Touka，这句台词真没你脑子里想的那么妙。
: {i}你说什么{/i}？你——

lines.en: : Yes. I know who you are.
lines.zh: : 对。我知道你是谁。

lines.en: : Heheh...you tell her, Sensei. You’re such a good boy.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……说她，Sensei。你真乖。

lines.en: : Good boys like you...they deserve rewards.
lines.zh: : 像你这样的好孩子……就该得到奖励。
: 所以——
: 给你～

lines.en: : Touka? Any...counterattack to Chika’s new tactic?
lines.zh: : Touka？对 Chika 的新战术……有什么反击吗？
: 我靠，她没事吧？

lines.en: : Forget about her. Let’s make out.
lines.zh: : 别管她。我们亲亲。
: 怎么了？……

lines.en: : I...really don’t think we should right now.
lines.zh: : 我……真觉得我们现在不该这样。
: 哼，我不同意！挪开点……

lines.en: I try to get off of the bed to make sure Touka didn’t hit her head on any sharp corners or anything, but am immediately prevented from doing so by the only contestant still standing...
lines.zh: 我想下床确认 Touka 没把脑袋磕在什么尖角上，却被场上唯一还「站着」的选手拦住了……
好吧……其实也算不上{i}站着了{/i}，不过——
你懂我意思。

lines.en: : What does this pose make you wanna do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这姿势让你想干嘛，Sensei？

lines.en: : Check the vital signs of a dying noblewoman.
lines.zh: : 检查一个垂死贵妇的生命体征。

lines.en: : What’s so {i}*hic*{/i} noble about...passing out in the middle of a contest?...
lines.zh: : 比赛进行到一半就昏过去……有什么{i}*嗝*{/i}好「贵」的？……

lines.en: : I bet she...couldn’t even figure out how to unhook that fancy bra of hers...
lines.zh: : 我打赌她……连她那件高级胸罩的扣子都不知道怎么解……
: 对了……我的胸罩跑哪去了？

lines.en: : Can you at least check if she’s bleeding?
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少看看她流血没有？

lines.en: : Can you at least take your pants off and fuck me before she wakes up?
lines.zh: : 你能不能至少把裤子脱了、趁她没醒先跟我来一发？
: 我……我看见一道光……
: 哦……不是……那……只是……我的手机……
: 我想她醒了，Chika。

lines.en: : Then what do we have to worry about?
lines.zh: : 那我们还有什么好担心的？

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t know. {i}Her remembering us having sex while she’s in need and then having both of us killed.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。比如{i}她记起我们在她需要人照顾时还做爱，然后把咱俩都杀了{/i}。

lines.en: : Then we die together like {i}*hic*{/i} Romeo and Juliet...it will be cute.
lines.zh: : 那我们就跟{i}*嗝*{/i}罗密欧与朱丽叶一样死在一起……多浪漫。
: 行了，比赛结束。

lines.en: : I sincerely thank you for the massive erection you have given me, but I am not nearly drunk enough to have reciprocative inebriated sex with you next to a girl with a minor concussion.
lines.zh: : 衷心感谢你赐我的这根硬到不行的鸡巴，但我可没醉到能在一个轻度脑震荡的女孩旁边跟你互相醉酒做爱。

lines.en: : And you call yourself a penis.
lines.zh: : 你还有脸自称阴茎。

lines.en: : I have never once called myself that.
lines.zh: : 我可从来没这么自称过。
: 哦天……我……突然觉得……好恶心。
: 而我……突然觉得……好困……
: 哦不。
: 晚安……Sensei……

lines.en: Chika passes out and...I am suddenly at a loss for exactly how I am supposed to handle this situation.
lines.zh: Chika 昏睡过去，而我……突然完全不知道该怎么收拾这局面。

lines.en: The two of them are passed out, half naked, and incapable of walking.
lines.zh: 她们俩都昏睡着，半裸，走不了路。

lines.en: And what’s even worse is that I didn’t even get to choose a winner yet.
lines.zh: 更糟的是，我连赢家都还没选出来。
不过没关系。

lines.en: Because an amazing idea just popped into my head.
lines.zh: 因为我刚想到一个绝妙的主意。

lines.en: I slide my phone out of my pocket and tap the name of the only person I can trust at a time like this.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出手机，点开这种时刻我唯一能信任的人的名字。

lines.en: : I need your help with something.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮个忙。

lines.en: : And I need you to never breathe a word about this to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 而且这事你绝不能让任何别人知道。
: 忙活了一晚上？

lines.en: : I...didn’t know who else to call.
lines.zh: : 我……实在不知道还能找谁。

lines.en: : You certainly made the correct decision.
lines.zh: : 你显然做了正确的决定。

lines.en: : Just...to address one of the several elephants in the room, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……先说清这屋里明摆着的几个问题之一……

lines.en: : These two {i}were{/i} conscious when they arrived, correct?
lines.zh: : 她们俩到的时候{i}还是{/i}清醒的，对吧？

lines.en: : I know what you’re thinking and no. I did not do this.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在想什么，不是。这不是我干的。

lines.en: : Then...I shall treat them as life-sized dolls and dress them back up before dragging them home.
lines.zh: : 那么……我就把她们当等身玩偶，给她们穿回衣服，再拖回家。

lines.en: : Would you...also be okay with informing them of who the winner is?
lines.zh: : 你……顺便也告诉她们赢家是谁，可以吗？

lines.en: : Is...is the real winner not you?
lines.zh: : 真正的赢家……难道不是你吗？

lines.en: : This was far from a victory for me.
lines.zh: : 这对我可远算不上赢。
: 真正的赢家是……
menu:
Chika 赢
: Chika。

lines.en: : She deserves it after the show she put on.
lines.zh: : 她那番表现，配得上。

lines.en: : You know, it would be really nice if you’d invite me to these sorts of “shows” before they happen from now on.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，以后再有这种「表演」，要是你能提前叫上我就好了。
Touka 赢
: Touka。
: 她尽力了。

lines.en: : I’d imagine her best would involve {i}slightly{/i} less underwear.
lines.zh: : 我猜她的「尽力」应该会再{i}少穿点{/i}内衣。

lines.en: : But yes. I will tell her.
lines.zh: : 不过，好。我会告诉她的。
: 还有，Sensei……
: 嗯，Nodoka？

lines.en: : I want you to know that you never cease to amaze me.
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道，你从来没停止过让我大开眼界。
: 谢了……
{i}Chika 的欲望提升到了 [chika_lust]！{/i}

[totaldays] 天过去了……

lines.en: I collapse into my hotel bed once more in a rather anticlimactic end to an action packed day.
lines.zh: 这忙碌的一天以相当扫兴的方式收尾，我又一次栽倒在酒店床上。

lines.en: I’m not sure what it was that compelled me to hang around the bar instead of coming back here earlier, but it is what it is.
lines.zh: 我不知道是什么让我在酒吧赖着不走、没早点回这儿，但事已至此。

lines.en: Housekeeping made my bed, and now I must lay in it.
lines.zh: 客房服务把我的床铺好了，现在我只能躺上去。

lines.en: I notice that Io never turned the air off after leaving this morning.
lines.zh: 我注意到 Io 今早走的时候没关空调。

lines.en: This is good because it saves me a trip across the room and will prevent a second injury for her should she manage to sneak in again.
lines.zh: 这挺好，省得我爬起来跑一趟——而且她要是再偷偷溜进来，也能免得再受一次伤。
不过我肯定她不会再来了。

lines.en: Not after discovering that I’m not the only person actively seeking something out with repeated knocks on the doors of people who may or may not want to see me at that given moment.
lines.zh: 毕竟她已经发现，我不是唯一一个会反复敲别人门、主动找点什么的人——而对方那一刻想不想见你还不一定。

lines.en: I close my eyes and accept, however, that there will always be someone who wants to see me at {i}every{/i} given moment.
lines.zh: 但我还是闭上眼，接受了这一点：{i}每一个{/i}时刻，总会有人想见我。

lines.en: There’s no real reason for it, really.
lines.zh: 其实没什么真正的理由。

lines.en: I just conveniently exist in a convenient place during a convenient crack in time.
lines.zh: 我只是恰好在一个恰好的时间裂缝里，恰好存在于一个恰好的地方。

lines.en: And, conveniently enough, I’ll be reminded of that all once more tomorrow morning-
lines.zh: 而巧的是，明早这一切又会重演——

lines.en: When every girl gathers around to hear the announcement of who it will be that can have me for one more night.
lines.zh: 到那时，每个女孩都会围过来，听那个宣布：今晚谁能再多拥有我一夜。
就一夜。
字面上就这么多。

lines.en: That’s what all of this was about.
lines.zh: 这一切就为了这个。
我真是受之有愧地被眷顾着。

lines.en: I fall asleep to the violent whir of an air conditioner working its non-existent heart out.
lines.zh: 我在空调那拼着命却毫无意义的轰鸣声里睡着了。
